findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_campaigns, get_campaign, top_alpha_now, get_brief, get_moments, get_assets, plan_clips, show_campaign, browse_campaigns · Private data: board_summary, get_brief, get_moments, get_assets, plan_clips, get_campaign_analytics · Public sink: search_campaigns, get_campaign, top_alpha_now, get_brief, get_moments, get_assets, plan_clips, show_campaign, browse_campaigns · Destructive: search_campaigns, get_brief, get_moments, get_assets, get_campaign_analytics, compare_campaigns, save_campaign, delete_alert_rule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_campaigns, get_campaign, top_alpha_now, get_brief, get_moments, get_assets, plan_clips, show_campaign, browse_campaigns · Private data: board_summary, get_brief, get_moments, get_assets, plan_clips, get_campaign_analytics · Public sink: search_campaigns, get_campaign, top_alpha_now, get_brief, get_moments, get_assets, plan_clips, show_campaign, browse_campaigns · Destructive: search_campaigns, get_brief, get_moments, get_assets, get_campaign_analytics, compare_campaigns, save_campaign, delete_alert_rule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
